title: The steward's ask event (steward, The confirmation dialogue; GA-CONF-5): the question a plan with an ask step puts, with the asked steps, so the asked endpoint sees what it confirms; personal values in it withheld as in a plan (GA-AUTH-7)

steps.description: One per asked step, in the order of step_ids, each field as the plan's step gives it (steward, Steps); given only to a read bound to the ask's endpoint, by the plan's credential, or whose derived role is owner, every other read getting the event without it (GA-CONF-5)

oneOf.description: An asked step on a device
A define's confirm_define step, its own shape (steward, Steps)

run_id.description: The scenario run that asked, on a run's toggle step asked again (GA-SCN-3); optional

endpoint.description: Where the question is put: the plan's endpoint, or the confirm_on that applies
